name: Frame drum daf 4/4
desc: Persian daf / frame drum with deep center booms (speed set by tune) against bright rim slaps (speed 1.3) — the rim/center contrast is the groove. A jingle-ring ghost roll shimmers on the high subdivisions, a rotating rim euclid, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, and a lastOf(4) roll fill. Peak drives a 16th jingle roll with iter rotation.

code.full: stack(s("framedrum ~ ~ framedrum <framedrum [framedrum ~]> ~ framedrum ~").speed(${tune}).gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.22).lpf(sine.range(1000,2400).slow(28)), s("~ ~ framedrum framedrum ~ framedrum ~ framedrum").speed(1.3).gain(".4 .24 .34 .2 .36 .22 .3 .2").hpf(700).pan(cosine.range(.36,.64).slow(16)), s("[~ framedrum]*8").speed(1.5).gain("[.12 .18 .1 .16]*2").hpf(1100).pan(sine.range(.5,.7).slow(20))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("framedrum ~ framedrum framedrum framedrum ~ framedrum framedrum").speed(${tune}).gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.25).lpf(sine.range(1200,3000).slow(16)), s("framedrum framedrum ~ framedrum framedrum framedrum ~ framedrum").speed(1.3).gain(".42 .26 .2 .36 .3 .24 .2 .34").hpf(700).pan(cosine.range(.32,.68).slow(12)), s("framedrum*16").speed(1.5).gain("[.16 .08 .12 .07]*4").hpf(1100).pan(sine.range(.45,.72).slow(16)), s("framedrum(5,16,<0 4 8 12>)").speed(1.15).gain(${gain}*.4).shape(.2)).lastOf(2, x=>x.fast(2)).iter(8).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
